classification.difficultyReason: Construct familiar circle shapes from given radii, a diameter and central angles.

content.prompt: Use your compasses, ruler and protractor to draw:

answer.worked: Mark a centre. Use the ruler to set the compass opening to $3\text{ cm}$. Keep the compass point at the centre and turn the pencil through a full revolution.

spec.description: Authored circle construction with its radius identified.

answer.short: A circle of diameter $8\text{ cm}$ and radius $4\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
$$r=8\div2=4\text{ cm}.$$
Mark a centre. Set the compass opening to $4\text{ cm}$ using the ruler, then draw a full circle about the centre.

spec.description: Authored circle construction with its diameter identified.

children.label: c
children.prompt: a sector with radius $5\text{ cm}$ and an angle of $110^{\circ}$ at the centre

answer.short: A sector of radius $5\text{ cm}$ with central angle $110^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: Draw a $5\text{ cm}$ radius from a centre. At the centre, use the protractor to mark $110^{\circ}$ from that radius. Draw the second radius of length $5\text{ cm}$ through the mark. With the compass point at the centre and opening $5\text{ cm}$, join the outer endpoints with the arc inside the $110^{\circ}$ angle.

spec.description: Authored minor sector bounded by two radii and their joining arc.

answer.short: A semicircle of radius $4\text{ cm}$ and diameter $8\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked: Draw an $8\text{ cm}$ diameter and mark its midpoint. Set the compass opening to $4\text{ cm}$. With the compass point at the midpoint, draw a half-circle joining the diameter's endpoints.

spec.description: Authored semicircle with a diameter boundary and marked centre.

answer.short: A quadrant of radius $5\text{ cm}$ with central angle $90^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: Draw a $5\text{ cm}$ radius. At its centre endpoint, use the protractor to construct a $90^{\circ}$ angle and draw a second radius of length $5\text{ cm}$. With the compass point at the centre and opening $5\text{ cm}$, join the outer endpoints with a quarter-circle arc.

spec.description: Authored quadrant with perpendicular radius boundaries.
